PTE 备考指南

本目录包含 PTE Academic 考试的备考资料，帮助你系统化地准备考试。

内容概览

| 文档 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| PTE 三个月备考计划 | 系统化的备考日历，分为基础、强化、冲刺三个阶段 |
| PTE 评分标准与实用技巧 | 各题型评分细则、策略建议和实用技巧汇总 |

备考阶段

第一阶段：基础夯实（第 1-4 周）
重点：RA、RS、WFD 核心题型
目标：熟悉题型，建立发音基础

第二阶段：强化提升（第 5-8 周）
重点：全题型涉猎，均衡训练
目标：技巧训练，提升速度

第三阶段：冲刺突破（第 9-12 周）
重点：机经冲刺，高频预测
目标：查漏补缺，模考冲刺

目标分数参考

| 要求类型 | 各项分数 |
|----------|----------|
| 配偶加分 | 30+ |
| 一般要求 | 50+ |
| 较高要求 | 65+ |
| 高分要求 | 79+ |

推荐资源
APEUni - 免费题库 + 机经
PTE Official - 官方模拟题
PTE Magic - 口语评分

title: PTE 评分标准与实用技巧
description: PTE 各题型评分细则、策略建议和实用技巧汇总
content:
PTE 评分标准与实用技巧

Speaking 评分标准

Read Aloud (RA) 评分标准

Read Aloud 是 PTE 口语部分最重要的题型，同时贡献 Speaking 和 Reading 分数。

三个评分维度

| 维度 | 评分内容 | 最高分 |
|------|---------|--------|
| Content（内容） | 是否按顺序正确朗读每个单词 | 5 分 |
| Pronunciation（发音） | 发音是否接近母语者标准 | 5 分 |
| Oral Fluency（流利度） | 是否流畅、无不必要停顿或自我纠正 | 5 分 |

评分细则

:::tabs
@tab Content 内容

评分范围：0-5 分

| 分数 | 标准 |
|------|------|
| 5 分 | 所有单词正确朗读，顺序正确 |
| 4 分 | 漏读/错读 1-2 个词 |
| 3 分 | 漏读/错读 3-4 个词 |
| 2 分 | 漏读/错读较多词 |
| 0 分 | 完全没读或全部错误 |

💡 按顺序读完所有单词即可得满分，跳过 1-2 个难词影响不大

@tab Pronunciation 发音

评分范围：0-5 分

| 分数 | 标准 |
|------|------|
| 5 分 | 所有元音、辅音发音准确，重音正确 |
| 4 分 | 大部分发音正确，少数错误不影响理解 |
| 3 分 | 部分发音有问题，但仍可理解 |
| 2 分 | 发音问题较多，理解困难 |
| 0 分 | 无法理解 |

💡 元音发饱满，辅音不吞音，注意单词重音和句子重音

@tab Oral Fluency 流利度

评分范围：0-5 分

| 分数 | 标准 |
|------|------|
| 5 分 | 语速自然，无明显停顿，节奏流畅 |
| 4 分 | 基本流畅，有少量犹豫 |
| 3 分 | 有明显停顿或重复 |
| 2 分 | 频繁停顿，语速不稳定 |
| 0 分 | 无法完成朗读 |

💡 保持自然语速，读错不要回读，根据意群合理停顿

:::

分数贡献

Read Aloud 同时贡献两个分数：
Speaking 分数：约占 25-30%
Reading 分数：约占 20-30%

::: warning 2025年8月更新

根据 Pearson 2025 年 8 月 7 日的更新：
Read Aloud 不再贡献 Reading 分数
RA 的整体权重有所降低
:::

RA 实用技巧

:::tabs
@tab 发音技巧

提升发音质量的关键要点

| 技巧 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| 元音饱满 | 元音发饱满，辅音不吞音 |
| 自然连读 | 该连读就连读，保持流畅 |
| 意群停顿 | 根据意群合理停顿，不随意断句 |
| 重读关键词 | 重读主语、谓语、宾语、状语 |

💡 录音回听是提升发音的最有效方法

@tab 避免扣分

常见扣分陷阱及应对策略

| 错误行为 | 正确做法 |
|----------|----------|
| 回读纠错 | 读错了继续往下读，不要回头 |
| 遇词卡壳 | 遇到生词根据拼读规则大胆读出来 |
| 语速不当 | 保持自然语速，不要太快或太慢 |
| 跳词过多 | 跳过 5 个词以内通常不会严重影响分数 |

⚠️ 流利度比完美发音更重要，保持自信流畅地朗读

:::

Reading 评分标准

PTE 阅读部分包含多种题型，每种题型的评分方式不同。

题型与分值

| 题型 | 题目数量 | 评分方式 | 分值贡献 |
|------|---------|---------|---------|
| Reading & Writing: Fill in the Blanks (RW-FIB) | 5-6 题 | 部分得分 | Reading + Writing |
| Multiple Choice, Multiple Answers (MC-MA) | 2-3 题 | 部分得分（错选扣分） | Reading |
| Re-order Paragraphs (RO) | 2-3 题 | 部分得分 | Reading |
| Reading: Fill in the Blanks (R-FIB) | 4-5 题 | 部分得分 | Reading |
| Multiple Choice, Single Answer (MC-SA) | 2-3 题 | 全对得分 | Reading |

各题型评分与技巧

:::tabs
@tab RW-FIB

Reading & Writing: Fill in the Blanks

评分规则：
每个空格正确 +1 分
错误或不填 0 分
同时贡献 Reading 和 Writing 分数

策略建议：

| 要点 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| 重要程度 | 最重要的阅读题型，同时影响两个分数 |
| 解题顺序 | 先看选项，再读文章 |
| 关注点 | 注意词性、搭配和语法 |

💡 这是性价比最高的题型，务必认真对待

@tab MC-MA

Multiple Choice, Multiple Answers

评分规则：
选对一个 +1 分
选错一个 -1 分
最低 0 分（不会负分）

策略建议：

| 原则 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| 谨慎选择 | 不确定的选项不要选 |
| 少选为上 | 宁可少选，不要错选 |
| 答案数量 | 通常正确答案 2-3 个 |

⚠️ 错选会倒扣分，宁缺勿滥

@tab RO

Re-order Paragraphs

评分规则：
按照相邻配对计分
每个正确的相邻配对 +1 分
例如：5 段文字，最多 4 个相邻配对，最高 4 分

策略建议：

| 步骤 | 方法 |
|------|------|
| 找开头段 | 无代词、无连接词引用的段落 |
| 找结尾段 | 总结性语句的段落 |
| 建立连接 | 注意代词指代和逻辑连接词 |

💡 先确定首尾，再填充中间

@tab R-FIB

Reading: Fill in the Blanks

评分规则：
每个空格正确 +1 分
拖拽选项到正确位置
只贡献 Reading 分数

策略建议：

| 技巧 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| 词性判断 | 根据语法判断空格需要的词性 |
| 语境推断 | 利用上下文语境选择 |
| 排除干扰 | 多余选项是干扰项，先排除 |

💡 先做有把握的空，再处理难的

@tab MC-SA

Multiple Choice, Single Answer

评分规则：
选对 +1 分
选错 0 分
只有一个正确答案

策略建议：

| 原则 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| 时间分配 | 分值较低，不要花太多时间 |
| 排除法 | 快速排除明显错误选项 |
| 保守策略 | 不确定时选最保守的答案 |

💡 性价比最低的题型，快速完成即可

:::

阅读分数计算

PTE 阅读分数来源于以下题型：

分数权重估计（非官方）：

| 题型 | 权重估计 | 重要程度 |
|------|---------|---------|
| RW-FIB | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ | 最高（双计分） |
| R-FIB | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ | 高 |
| RO | ⭐⭐⭐ | 中高 |
| MC-MA | ⭐⭐ | 中 |
| MC-SA | ⭐ | 低 |

时间分配建议

总时间：29-30 分钟

| 题型 | 建议时间 | 每题时间 |
|------|---------|---------|
| RW-FIB | 10-12 分钟 | 2 分钟/题 |
| MC-MA | 3-4 分钟 | 1.5 分钟/题 |
| RO | 6-8 分钟 | 2.5 分钟/题 |
| R-FIB | 6-8 分钟 | 1.5 分钟/题 |
| MC-SA | 2-3 分钟 | 1 分钟/题 |

::: danger 重要提醒
阅读和写作共享时间（29-30 分钟）
先做高分值题型（RW-FIB、R-FIB）
不要在 MC-SA 上花太多时间
宁可猜答案也不要超时
:::

目标分数参考

| 移民/学校要求 | 听力 | 阅读 | 口语 | 写作 |
|--------------|------|------|------|------|
| 一般要求 | 50+ | 50+ | 50+ | 50+ |
| 较高要求 | 65+ | 65+ | 65+ | 65+ |
| 高分要求 | 79+ | 79+ | 79+ | 79+ |

title: RL-Template
content:
Template 1The lecture demonstrates ...Specifically, ...Furthermore, ...In addition, ...As a result / In conclusion, ...

Template 2The lecture was about [Topic words].Firstly, the speaker was talking about [1 or 2 words].Secondly, he was mentioning [1 or 2 words].Thirdly, he was explaining [1 or 2 words].It gives important information about many facts. Finally, the lecture was all about [Repeat the topic].

title: Writing Essay - Template
content:
The Final Template (Reduced blanks — ~7 per essay)

Paragraph 1 — Introduction

In today's fast changing world, many topics keep getting public attention and debate. One such topic is [topic]. While people have different views on this matter, I believe that [your view]. This essay will look at the main parts of this topic and show why this view makes sense through clear reasons and good examples.

Paragraph 2 — First Main Argument

To start with, one key point is that [first argument and why it matters]. This means that it has a real effect on this topic. For example, [first evidence or example], which clearly shows the value of this point. So, this reason strongly supports my view on this topic.

Paragraph 3 — Second Main Argument (or Counterargument + Response)

Next, another important point is that [second argument and why it matters]. This is because it plays a big role in this area. For example, [second evidence or example] shows how this part affects the topic. Even though some may have a different view, the overall proof supports my position.

Paragraph 4 — Conclusion

In summary, this is a big topic with many views. After looking at the main points and proof, it is clear that [restate your conclusion]. In the end, having a careful and fair view of this topic will help people and society make better choices in the future.

title: RL/SST/SGD Template
content:
.pronoun {
  color: pink;
  font-weight: bold;
  font-style: italic;
}


.blank {
  color: orange;
  font-weight: bold;
  font-style: italic;
}


::: details Deprecated Tempalte

The Unified Template 

::: tabs

@tab 6 lines

The [lecture/discussion] provides information on  (main topic/theme) and highlights several key aspects.

To begin with, the [speaker(s)/participants] introduce  (first key idea / general concept) and give some background details.

Next, they discuss  (second key idea / development / change) and explain the reasons or ideas related to it.

Furthermore, they illustrate and evaluate  (example / case + opinion or viewpoint) with supporting details.

Finally, an important point about  (key takeaway / conclusion point) is emphasized toward the end.

In conclusion, the [lecture/discussion] offers valuable insights into  (overall summary of topic) and is overall informative.

@tab 7 lines

The [lecture/discussion] provides information on  (main topic/theme) and highlights several key aspects.

To begin with, the [speaker(s)/participants] introduce  (first key idea / general concept) and give some background details.

Next, they discuss  (second key idea / development / change) and explain the reasons or ideas related to it.

Furthermore, they illustrate  (specific example / case / situation) with examples or supporting details.

In addition, different views on  (controversial point / opinion / issue) are mentioned, including agreement or disagreement.

Finally, an important point about  (key takeaway / warning / conclusion point) is emphasized toward the end.

In conclusion, the [lecture/discussion] offers valuable insights into  (overall summary of topic) and is overall informative.

:::

:::

--- 

RL/SST Tempalte
The lecture gives information on [Topic] and highlights several key points.

Firstly, the speaker talks about [first key idea / general concept].

Later, the speaker gives information about  [second key idea / development / change] and explains the reasons behind it.

Furthermore, the speaker illustrates the point with an example of  [specific example / case / situation].

In the end, they emphasize an important note on  [key takeaway / warning / conclusion point].

In conclusion, the lecture offers valuable insights into [Topic] and is very informative.



SGD Template
The discussion involves several people/students/teachers talking about [Topic].

First of all, the first speaker talks about [first key idea / general concept].
 Later, he/she provides more information about [details, reasons, or explanation] and explains the reasons behind it.
 Furthermore, the first speaker illustrates the point with an example of [specific example, case, or scenario supporting the idea].
 In the end, the first speaker emphasizes an important note on [key takeaway, conclusion point, or caution].

Following the first speaker, the second speaker turns to [second key idea / general concept].
 Later, he/she provides more information about [details, reasons, or explanation] and explains the reasons behind it.
 Furthermore, the first speaker illustrates the point with an example of [specific example, case, or scenario supporting the idea].
 In the end, the first speaker emphasizes an important note on [key takeaway, conclusion point, or caution].

As for the third speaker, he/she shares view on [the idea].
 Later, he/she provides more information about [details, reasons, or explanation] and explains the reasons behind it.
 Furthermore, the first speaker illustrates the point with an example of [specific example, case, or scenario supporting the idea].In the end, the first speaker emphasizes an important note on [key takeaway, conclusion point, or caution].

In conclusion, the discussion focuses on [Topic] and examines [overall ideas, issues, or key points discussed by all speakers] throughout the dialogue.

content:
Asking a Librarian for Help with a Broken Photocopier 图书馆复印机坏了 #221001 极高频 极限预测 简单

You were trying to photocopy a document at the library, but you find the photocopier not working and there is a flashing light next to the photocopy icon. You want to ask the librarian to help you. What would you say?

你当时正在图书馆里试图复印一份文件，但发现复印机无法正常工作，而且复印图标旁边还闪烁着指示灯。你想向图书馆管理员寻求帮助。你会怎么说？

::: details Sample Answer

Excuse me! I was trying to photocopy a document, but it seems the machine isn't working. There's a flashing light next to the photocopy icon, but I don't know how to fix it. Could you please help me with it? Thanks a lot!

:::

::: details Template Answer

Hi, do you have a moment?
I'd like to talk to you about the photocopier at the library.
The situation is that I was trying to photocopy a document, but I found the photocopier not working and there is a flashing light next to the photocopy icon.
This is important because I need to photocopy this document urgently.
I was wondering if you could help me with it.
I'd really appreciate it.

photocopier /ˈfoʊtəˌkɑːpiər/ n. 复印机

Asking Someone to Lower Noise in the Library 图书馆让人降低噪音 #221002 极高频 简单

You have an assignment due next week. Now you are in the library, but someone next to you is playing a video without headphones. You are too distracted to focus on your study. You should have a conversation with him to make sure you have a quiet place. What would you say?

你有一项作业下周要交。此刻你正在图书馆里，但你旁边有人正在不戴耳机的情况下播放视频。你因此分心，无法专心学习。你应该和他谈谈，确保你能在一个安静的地方学习。你会怎么说？

::: details Sample Answer

Hi, sorry to bother you! I'm currently working on an assignment that's due next week, and I came to the library hoping for a quiet space to concentrate. But I noticed you're playing a video without headphones, and it's quite hard for me to focus. Would you mind lowering the volume or using headphones, please? I'd really appreciate it.

:::

::: details Template Answer

Hi, do you have a moment?
I'd like to talk to you about the noise in the library.
The situation is that I have an assignment due next week, but you are playing a video without headphones, and I am too distracted to focus on my study.
This is important because I need a quiet place to concentrate on my assignment.
I was wondering if you could lower the volume or use headphones.
I'd really appreciate it.

You are interested in applying for a job in the school cafe. You know that the boss is looking for someone with experience, which you are actually currently lacking. However, you are eager to learn and determined to work hard. What do you have to say to get this chance?

你有意申请学校食堂的工作。你知道老板正在寻找有工作经验的人，而你目前确实缺乏这方面的能力。不过，你渴望学习并且决心努力工作。为了获得这个机会，你打算怎么说呢？

::: details Sample Answer

Hi! I heard you're looking for someone to work at the school café. I know you're hoping to find someone with experience, and I'll be honest—I haven't worked in a café before. But I'm very eager to learn, and I'm a fast learner who's not afraid of hard work. Would it be possible for you to consider giving me the opportunity? I'd really appreciate the chance to prove myself!

Hi, do you have a moment?
I'd like to talk to you about the job in the school cafe.
The situation is that I am interested in applying for the job, and I know you are looking for someone with experience, which I am actually currently lacking.
This is important because I am eager to learn and determined to work hard.
I was wondering if you could give me the opportunity to prove myself.

You share a flat with a roommate, but you find your food in fridge disappearing. You notice there may be a visitor of your roommate to eat your food. You feel that they don't obey the rules, how do you ask your roommate about this situation?

你和室友合住一个公寓，但是你发现冰箱里的食物不见了。你注意到室友可能会来吃你的食物。你觉得他们不遵守规则，你怎么问你的室友这种情况？

::: details Sample Answer

Hi! I've noticed that some of my food in the fridge has been disappearing lately. I'm wondering maybe one of your visitors might be eating it. I feel like this is going against the rules we agreed on for sharing the kitchen. Could we talk about this and find a way to make sure it doesn't happen again?

:::

::: details Template Answer

Hi, do you have a moment?
I'd like to talk to you about my food in the fridge.
The situation is that I find my food in the fridge disappearing, and I notice there may be a visitor of yours eating my food.
This is important because I feel that they don't obey the rules we agreed on.
I was wondering if you could talk about this and find a way to make sure it doesn't happen again.
I'd really appreciate it.

You notice a part-time job information (advertising) of cafeteria on campus, but you want to know more information about this job and you don't know what is required for this part-time job. You want to ask the manager about this job, how do you ask?

Hi! I saw the advertisement for the part-time job at the campus cafeteria, and I'm really interested. But I don't have much experience with this kind of work in the past, so I'd like to learn more about the job responsibilities and requirements. Could you please tell me more about what the role involves and what skills you're looking for?

I'd like to talk to you about the part-time job at the campus cafeteria.
The situation is that I noticed the advertisement for the part-time job, and I'm really interested, but I don't know what is required for this job.
This is important because I want to know more about the job responsibilities and requirements.
I was wondering if you could tell me more about what the role involves and what skills you're looking for.
I'd really appreciate it.

You borrowed a book from the university library, but while reading it, you notice that two pages has been torn out, but you didn't do it. What do you say to the librarian when you return the book?

你从大学图书馆借了一本书，但在阅读过程中，你发现有两页被撕掉了，但这件事并非由你造成。当你归还这本书时，你会对图书馆员说什么呢？

Excuse me! I borrowed this book last week, and while I was reading it, I noticed that two pages were torn out. I just want to let you know that I didn't cause the damage. Could you please make a note of it so it's not recorded as my responsibility?

The situation is that while I was reading it, I noticed that two pages have been torn out, but I didn't do it.

Your flatmates are holding a party in their room at night, which is too noisy for you to sleep, but you have an important exam early tomorrow morning. What should you say to them?

你的室友们晚上要在他们的房间里举办聚会，那声音太吵了，影响你睡觉。但明天一大早你还有重要的考试要参加。你会对他们说什么呢？

The situation is that you are holding a party in your room at night, which is too noisy for me to sleep.

Your neighbor is holding a party with loud music in the living room at night, which is too noisy and influences your sleep, but you have an important exam early tomorrow morning. What should you say to them without causing an argument?

你的邻居在晚上把音乐开得很大声，在客厅里举行聚会，这声音太吵了，影响了你的睡眠，而明天早上你还有重要的考试要参加。你该如何委婉地跟他们说这件事，同时又避免引发争执呢？

Book to return 请朋友还书 #221009 极高频 简单

You lent a book to a classmate three weeks ago, and he hasn't returned it yet. Now, you need the book very much. What would you say to him?

三周前你曾借给一位同学一本书，但他至今仍未归还。现在你非常需要这本书。你会对他说些什么呢？

Hi, I hope you're enjoying that book I lent you a few weeks ago. I just wanted to check in because I actually need it back now for my upcoming exam preparation. Would it be possible for you to return it by tomorrow? I'd really appreciate it! Thanks so much for understanding!

title: Writing Essay - Template
content:
First Template

The First Paragraph
In today's complex world, numerous issues and topics are subject to debate. One such topic is [topic]. While it is true that every topic has its own set of advantages and disadvantages, my view is that [You view is here]. This essay will explore the various scenarios of the topic and demonstrate the viewpoint with a logical narrative.

The Second Paragraph
To begin with, one prominent aspect of [topic] is . This means [details to support you view]. To quote a recent instance, [provide an example that illustrates the advantage]. In conclusion, the aforementioned points justify the viewpoint.

Third paragraph
Secondly, one notable feature is [xxxx]. This is due to the fact that [supporting ideas]. For example, a recent report by the prestigious University of the West proves the validity of the statement with all the available logical  evidence. 法律改变人的行为 #101003 极高频 极限预测

::: tabs

@tab Question

Some people think human behaviors can be changed by laws, while others think laws have little effect. What is your opinion.
一些人认为法律可以限制人的行为，另一些人认为法律没有什么作用。你的意见是什么?

::: details 观点1：可以限制
Personally speaking, human behaviors can be changed by laws.
 论点1：防止犯罪
Laws can prevent people from taking part in crime.
   参考论证1：法律 – 惩罚 – 避免犯罪
[legislations] – [punishments and penalties] – [reduced criminal behavior]
   参考论证2：法律 – 定义犯罪行为 – 避免犯法
[rules and regulations] – [definition of criminal behaviors] – [the avoidance of crime]
 论点2：正确价值观
Laws can help shape citizens' sense of morality and influence their behavior.
   参考论证1：法律 – 定义道德标准 – 道德行为
[laws and legislations] – [moral standards] – [ethical conduct]
   参考论证2：法律 – 清晰的行为准则 – 遵守法律的行为
[rules and regulations] – [clear behavioral boundaries] – [lawful compliance]
 论点3：承担社会责任
Laws can guide people to assume their social responsibilities.
   参考论证1：法律 – 建立社会责任感 – 对社会负责的行为
[laws and legislations] – [a sense of public duty] – [responsible conduct]
   参考论证2：法律 – 法律义务 – 实现法律责任
[rules and regulations] – [legal obligations] – [the fulfilment of civic duties]

:::

::: details 观点2：不能限制
Personally speaking, laws have little effect on human behaviors.
 论点1：法律约束无法限制内在动机
Legal control have limited capacity to regulate people's internal motivations and behaviors.
   参考论证1：法律 – 建立社会责任感 – 对社会负责的行为
[laws and legislation] – [external constraints] – [limited influence on personal choices]
   参考论证2：法律 – 法律义务 – 实现法律责任
[rules and regulation] – [limited fear of punishiment] – [temporary compliance]
 论点2：法律缺乏执行力
Law's limited enforcement reduces the ability to regulate behavior.
参考论证1：法律 – 执行力有限 – 震慑作用低
[laws and legislation] – [enforcement gaps] – [low deterrent effect]
参考论证2：法律 – 监管能力不足 – 规避合法行为
[rules and regulation] – [weak supervision] – [rule avoidance]
论点3：法律不能预防犯罪行为
Laws are unable to prevent legal violation.
参考论证1：法律 – 以惩罚为主的机制 – 预防作用有限
[laws and legislation] – [punishment-based measures] – [weak preventive effect]
参考论证2：法律 – 事后型执行方式 – 行为预防能力不足
[rules and regulation] – [reactive enforcement] – [limited behavioral prevention]

:::

@tab Answer

 Paragraph 1 — Introduction

  In today's fast changing world, many topics keep getting public attention and debate. One such topic is laws changing behavior. While people have different views on this matter, I believe that laws change behavior. This essay will look at the main parts of this topic and show why this view makes sense through clear reasons and good examples.

 Paragraph 2 — First Main Argument

  To start with, one key part of legal influence is crime prevention. This means that legislations reduce crime. For example, regulations prevent crime, which clearly shows the value of this point. So, this reason strongly supports the idea that laws deter crime.

 Paragraph 3 — Second Main Argument

  Next, another important point is shaping moral values. This is because laws define morality. For example, regulations ensure compliance shows how this part affects the topic. Even though some may say that limited internal regulation, the overall proof suggests that social responsibilities.

 Paragraph 4 — Conclusion

  In summary, laws and behavior is a big topic with many views. After looking at the main points and proof, it is clear that laws prevent crime. In the end, having a careful and fair view of this topic will help people and society make better choices in the future.

:::

员工参与决策的利弊 #101004 极高频 极限预测

::: tabs

@tab Question

In some companies, some employers involve employees in the decision-making process of products and services. What are the advantages and disadvantages of such a policy?
有些雇主会让员工参与产品和服务的决策过程。这种政策的优点和缺点是什么?

::: details 观点：既有优点，也有缺点
Personally speaking, I firmly believe that there are both advantages and disadvantages of such a policy.
 论点1：增加员工忠诚度
Employees' participation in the decision-making process of products and services can result in high employee loyalty.
   参考论证1：员工参与决策 – 工作参与度 – 归属感
[employees making decisions] – [more engagement in work] – [a sense of belonging]
   参考论证2：员工参与决策 – 动力和热情 – 忠诚度
[involving employees in the decision-making process] – [their motivation and passion] – [higher employment loyalty]
 论点2：提高工作表现
Involving employees in the decision-making process of products and services will lead to better business performance.
   参考论证1：员工参与决策 – 更好的商业建议 – 更高的公司收入
[employees making decisions] – [better business suggestions] – [more business revenue]
   参考论证2：员工参与决策 – 满足顾客需求 – 顾客认可度
[involving employees in the decision-making process] – [meeting clients' demand] – [customers' recognition]

:::

::: details 缺点
 论点1：产生上下级矛盾
Employees participating in the decision-making process may create conflicts between employees and managers.
   参考论证1：员工参与决策 – 意见不同和争执 – 老板员工之间的冲突
[staff participation] – [disagreement or arguments] – [conflicts among employees and employers]
   参考论证2：员工参与决策 – 不同意见 – 管理层和员工之间关系紧张
[staff engagement in decision making] – [different opinions] – [tensions between management and employees]
 论点2：降低工作效率
Employees engaged in the decision-making process will cause a decrease in working efficiency.
   参考论证1：员工参与决策 – 复杂的协商流程 – 浪费时间
[employee involvement in decision making] – [complex negotiation procedures] – [waste of time]
   参考论证2：员工参与决策 – 冗长的讨论时间 – 拖慢工作进度
[employee engagement in the decision process] – [longer discussion time] – [slower work progress]

:::

@tab Answer

 Paragraph 1 — Introduction

  In today's fast changing world, many topics keep getting public attention and debate. One such topic is employee decision-making involvement. While people have different views on this matter, I believe that both advantages and disadvantages. This essay will look at the main parts of this topic and show why this view makes sense through clear reasons and good examples.

 Paragraph 2 — Advantages

  To start with, one main benefit of employee decision-making is higher employee loyalty. This means that decisions increase belonging. For example, involvement boosts loyalty, which clearly shows the good effect. So, this reason strongly supports the idea that participation enhances commitment.

 Paragraph 3 — Disadvantages

  However, there are also clear downsides. One big concern is creating workplace conflicts. This is because participation causes conflicts. For example, engagement creates tensions shows the bad effect. Despite these problems, a fair view of both sides is still needed for employee decision-making.

 Paragraph 4 — Conclusion

  In summary, employee decision-making is a big topic with both gains and losses. After looking at the main points and proof, it is clear that loyalty increases, conflicts arise. In the end, having a careful and fair view of this topic will help people and society make better choices in the future.

:::

书面考试是否有效评估学习成果 #101005 极高频 极限预测

::: tabs

@tab Question

The formal written examination can be a valid method to assess students' learning. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Use your own experience.
正式的笔试是评估学生学习成绩的有效方法。你在多大程度上同意或不同意? 运用你自己的经验。

::: details 观点1：是有效方法
Personally speaking, I firmly believe that a formal written examination can be a valid method to assess students' learning.
 论点1：准确评估知识掌握程度
A formal written examination can lead to a clear measurement of knowledge mastery.
   参考论证1：笔试 – 数字化成绩 – 学习结果准确评估
[formal written examination] – [quantified scores] – [accurate assessment of learning outcomes]
   参考论证2：笔试 – 数字化考试结果 – 学业表现准确评估
[written examinations] – [numerical test outcomes] – [precise evaluation of academic performance]
 论点2：客观测试学习成果
A formal written examination can ensure removal of subjectivity in grading.
   参考论证1：笔试 – 考试形式统一 – 无主观偏差
[formal written examination] – [identical test formats] – [bias-free evaluation]
   参考论证2：笔试 – 考试流程统一客观学术评价
[written examinations] – [standardized procedures] – [objective academic evaluation]
 论点3：全面测试学习成果
Formal written examination can result in comprehensive understanding of students' learning outcomes.
   参考论证1：笔试 – 精细的题目设计 – 全面检测学生知识漏洞
[formal written examination] – [careful exam item design] – [identification of learning deficiencies]
   参考论证2：笔试 – 有代表性的题目选取 – 检测学生重点知识点掌握情况
[written examination] – [representative question selection] – [assessment of core concept mastery]

:::

::: details 观点2：不是有效方法
Personally speaking, I firmly believe that a formal written examination is not a valid method to assess students' learning.
 论点1：无法检验实践能力
Formal written examination can have inability to assess practical ability development.
   参考论证1：笔试 – 小组项目不足 – 难易检测团队合作力
[formal written examination] – [few group projects] – [failure to evaluate teamwork skills]
   参考论证2：笔试 – 注重理论 – 无法判断实践能力
[written examinations] – [focus on theory] – [limited measurement of problem-solving ability]
 论点2：成绩失真
Formal written examination can bring about distorted results under pressure.
   参考论证1：笔试 – 备考焦虑 – 无法反映实际水平
[formal written examination] – [exam anxiety] – [failure to reflect true mastery]
   参考论证2：笔试 – 考试时间紧张 – 匆忙作答/未完成作答
[written examinations] – [strict exam time limits] – [rushed responses / incomplete answers]
 论点3：不计过程（只重结果）
Formal written examination can lead to neglect of the learning process evaluation.
   参考论证1：笔试 – 应试记忆 – 无法审核是否知识内化
[formal written examination] – [test-oriented memorization] – [lack of assessing conceptual understanding]
   参考论证2：笔试 – 死记硬背 – 无法检验知识理解
[written examination] – [exam cramming] – [insufficient assessment of knowledge comprehension]

:::

@tab Answer

 Paragraph 1 — Introduction

  In today's fast changing world, many topics keep getting public attention and debate. One such topic is exams assessing learning. While people have different views on this matter, I believe that exams validly assess learning. This essay will look at the main parts of this topic and show why this view makes sense through clear reasons and good examples.

 Paragraph 2 — First Main Argument

  To start with, one key part of written examinations is measuring knowledge mastery. This means that exams provide accurate scores. For example, exams evaluate performance precisely, which clearly shows the value of this point. So, this reason strongly supports the idea that exams measure knowledge.

 Paragraph 3 — Second Main Argument

  Next, another important point is removing grading subjectivity. This is because exams ensure unbiased evaluation. For example, standardized procedures ensure objectivity shows how this part affects the topic. Even though some may say that exams neglect practical skills, the overall proof suggests that exams remain reliably valid.

 Paragraph 4 — Conclusion

  In summary, exams and learning assessment is a big topic with many views. After looking at the main points and proof, it is clear that exams measure knowledge objectively. In the end, having a careful and fair view of this topic will help people and society make better choices in the future.

:::

::: tabs

@tab Question

Personally speaking, I firmly believe that travel is a necessary component of quality education.

Travel can bring about new approaches to academic research.

[overseas travel] – [exposure to new mindsets] – [fresh research perspectives]

[overseas travel for education] – [interaction with foreign scholars] – [broader research ideas]

Travel can result in effective foreign language acquisition.
   参考论证1：出国旅行 – 与外国人交流 – 提升口语和听力能力
[traveling overseas] – [communication with locals] – [improved speaking and listening ability]
   参考论证2：出国游学 – 外语环境 – 第二语言迅速进步
[overseas travel for study] – [foreign language environment] – [rapid second-language progress]

[overseas study tour] – [transportation and accommodation costs] – [huge financial pressure]

Overseas travel can result in reduced learning efficiency.
   参考论证1：海外旅行 – 耗时适应环境 – 学习分心
[traveling overseas] – [time for adaptation] – [less focus on study]
   参考论证2：海外研学 – 社交分心 – 学习不自律
[overseas travel for study] – [social and shopping distractions] – [weaker academic discipline]

::: details 观点1：可以限制
Personally speaking, human behaviors can be changed by laws.
 论点1：防止犯罪Laws can prevent people from taking part in crime.
   参考论证1：法律 – 惩罚 – 避免犯罪[legislations] – [punishments and penalties] – [reduced criminal behavior]
   参考论证2：法律 – 定义犯罪行为 – 避免犯法[rules and regulations] – [definition of criminal behaviors] – [the avoidance of crime]
 论点2：正确价值观Laws can help shape citizens’ sense of morality and influence their behavior.
   参考论证1：法律 – 定义道德标准 – 道德行为[laws and legislations] – [moral standards] – [ethical conduct]
   参考论证2：法律 – 清晰的行为准则 – 遵守法律的行为[rules and regulations] – [clear behavioral boundaries] – [lawful compliance]
 论点3：承担社会责任Laws can guide people to assume their social responsibilities.
   参考论证1：法律 – 建立社会责任感 – 对社会负责的行为[laws and legislations] – [a sense of public duty] – [responsible conduct]
   参考论证2：法律 – 法律义务 – 实现法律责任[rules and regulations] – [legal obligations] – [the fulfilment of civic duties]

:::

::: details 观点2：不能限制
Personally speaking, laws have little effect on human behaviors.
 论点1：法律约束无法限制内在动机Legal control have limited capacity to regulate people’s internal motivations and behaviors.
   参考论证1：法律 – 建立社会责任感 – 对社会负责的行为[laws and legislation] – [external constraints] – [limited influence on personal choices]
   参考论证2：法律 – 法律义务 – 实现法律责任[rules and regulation] – [limited fear of punishiment] – [temporary compliance]
 论点2：法律缺乏执行力Law’s limited enforcement reduces the ability to regulate behavior.参考论证1：法律 – 执行力有限 – 震慑作用低[laws and legislation] – [enforcement gaps] – [low deterrent effect]参考论证2：法律 – 监管能力不足 – 规避合法行为[rules and regulation] – [weak supervision] – [rule avoidance]论点3：法律不能预防犯罪行为Laws are unable to prevent legal violation.参考论证1：法律 – 以惩罚为主的机制 – 预防作用有限[laws and legislation] – [punishment-based measures] – [weak preventive effect]参考论证2：法律 – 事后型执行方式 – 行为预防能力不足[rules and regulation] – [reactive enforcement] – [limited behavioral prevention]

:::

@tab Answer

 Paragraph 1 — Introduction

  In today’s rapidly evolving world, many issues continue to attract public attention and debate. One such issue is whether human behaviors can be changed by laws, or if laws have little effect. While different people hold different opinions regarding this matter, my view is that human behaviors can indeed be changed by laws. This essay will discuss the key aspects of the topic and explain why this perspective is reasonable through logical arguments and relevant examples.

 Paragraph 2 — First Main Argument

  To begin with, one major aspect of legal influence is its ability to prevent people from taking part in crime. This means that through legislations, punishments, and penalties, the legal system can lead to reduced criminal behavior. For instance, rules and regulations that provide a clear definition of criminal behaviors help citizens ensure the avoidance of crime, which clearly illustrates the importance of this factor. Therefore, this argument strongly supports the idea that laws serve as an effective deterrent.

 Paragraph 3 — Second Main Argument

  Secondly, another significant consideration is that laws can help shape citizens' sense of morality and influence their behavior. This is because laws and legislations define moral standards which lead to ethical conduct. For example, rules and regulations establishing clear behavioral boundaries result in lawful compliance demonstrates how this aspect affects the issue. Even though some may argue that legal controls have limited capacity to regulate internal motivations, the overall evidence suggests that laws guide people to assume their social responsibilities.

 Paragraph 4 — Conclusion

  In conclusion, the impact of laws on human behavior is a complex issue with multiple perspectives. After examining the main arguments and supporting evidence, it is clear that laws are effective in preventing crime and shaping moral standards. Ultimately, adopting a thoughtful and balanced understanding of this topic will help individuals and society make better decisions in the future.
+1
